summary: Current main still publishes an XRP signal with score 44 and confidence 0.0 while sentiment-provider calls fail, and the summary narrates positive headline sentiment. The paper trader still has a nonzero simulated position with position_product=null and a 30-minute schedule that commits/pushes state. Fresh-main PR #1320 has exact-head CI and gate passes but remains draft/unmerged. New PR #1323 proposes a read-only merge-queue workflow from current main; its files were read back and compare is 3 commits ahead, 0 behind, but CI/gate were not yet visible at capture. PR #1308 remains the corrective proposal for the unintended data-only file on main; it is still unmerged. No XRP forecast or market feature admission.
